Negative.

I earned all the achievements myself. I mostly played duos and squads.

The game used to be better. It felt more hardcore. Sure, it was clunky and inconvenient in some ways, but it had its own vibe and a community where skill actually mattered.

Things really started going to ♥♥♥♥ with the introduction of the Panzerfaust. The MP5 is already a complete circus, but even that pales in comparison to the current RPD. You get 100 rounds, damage, range, and a scope. That's it. That's the final nail in the coffin.

The game is also in a terrible technical state, and I'm not even talking about my GPU. Constant crashes, disconnects, getting stuck in the lobby, teammates' ready status constantly desyncing, potato servers, sudden packet loss while parachuting, and so on.

New features don't solve existing problems. Instead, additions like the craters from the Red Zone introduce even more randomness and reduce how much individual skill matters.

It's basically the exact same thing that happened with War Thunder. They kept loosening things up until the whole game turned into a complete circus. From the perspective of a picky online gamer, the game is simply ♥♥♥♥.

PUBG is following almost exactly the same path, except without the community wars.

They also keep trying to push third-person mode, although I guess most of their money probably comes from the Asian market and PUBG Mobile anyway.

The new maps are garbage too. Rondo is just ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ awful. I won't even get started on the skins.

The developers keep adding some new ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ supposedly to address the pile of existing problems. Credit where it's due, though: quick access to the match history is genuinely a good addition. Respect for that. Pretty much everything else is garbage.

During the update with the Jujutsu Kaisen collaboration, across six matches, I didn't get sent back to the lobby properly even once. Crashes, anti-cheat errors, account login errors — and some of those happened to both me and my teammate at literally the exact same second. +not working on linux due ♥♥♥♥♥♥ anticheat and Krafton. A lot of cheaters to, due free pubg+, trash. Etc and etc...


So yeah. That's about it.
